name: Ricardo Sepúlveda
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began with a childhood obsession with go-karts in Santiago. He excelled in mechanical engineering at the Universidad de Chile, immediately applying his knowledge to local racing teams. He quickly gained a reputation for his meticulous approach and ability to diagnose complex mechanical issues under pressure. After several successful years in Chilean rally and touring car series, he sought new challenges abroad, eventually landing a role with Erebus Motorsport.

Ricardo is a pragmatic engineer through and through, prioritizing reliability and performance above all else. He believes in a data-driven approach, rigorously analyzing telemetry and track conditions to optimize car setup. He's respected for his clear communication and ability to translate complex technical concepts into actionable insights for the drivers. He's known to push his team to be their best, always looking for marginal gains, and isn't afraid to challenge conventional wisdom if the data suggests a better path.

His calm demeanor and analytical mind make him a valuable asset in high-pressure situations. He is regarded as a rising star in the world of motorsport engineering.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave
physical.description: Ricardo is of average height and build with a focused, intense gaze.

Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on drinking mate every morning before starting work.
